items.item: 'crash monitor never signals before the crash by construction'

items.item: the weighted boundary function and its open-ended calibration
items.source_evidence: eq. (2.8): g(M,s) = c M^{1/2} (1 + s/M) (s/(M+s))^gamma, with c = c(gamma, alpha) chosen so that lim_{M->inf} P{tau_M < inf} = alpha under H0.
